metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Paco Lastdate
records.biography_en: His HyperNorm calendar has a designated day for events that were not meant to happen.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The emergency has been postponed to a more auspicious box.

records.name: Bram Brightstone
records.biography_en: He polishes away all ambiguous reflections for the Men in Black, then saves the dust.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The dust is acquiring opinions.

records.name: Mara Frothwise
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory demand an approved welcome; Mara pours it from an unapproved height.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Hospitality has exceeded the recommended foam.

records.name: Tomas Straightedge
records.biography_en: He gives each HyperNorm rebuilding a straighter edge and the same impossible plan.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The staircase has arrived at a philosophical objection.

records.name: Orrin Softbounce
records.biography_en: The Men in Black use his demonstrations to distract residents from the exposed card.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He is leading on points. Nobody has agreed what points are.

records.name: Lina Threadagain
records.biography_en: Her HyperNorm wraps use an official repeating pattern; one thread quietly takes another route.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The exception is holding the cloth together.
